audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart rows 0, 1, 2 and 4 disagree with the packet chart and with their own whys[] text.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Tryndamere/Tryndamere/Skill/Tryndamere/Skill/Tryndamere/Tryndamere. whys[0] and whys[1] already say 'favours Tryndamere' while win[0] said Ryze and win[1] said Skill; whys[2] and whys[4] say 'even skill' while the rows said Tryndamere and Ryze. The mirror audit also flipped rows 0 and 1 to Tryndamere.
audit.corrected: Rows 0 and 1 to Tryndamere, rows 2 and 4 to Skill, as matched full/content pairs with ratings.

audit.why: Ryze's lane spike is Spell Flux into Rune Prison at level 3; Realm Warp at 6 is 180s at rank 1 and a map tool, not a duel button, so 6 is Tryndamere's own Undying Rage spike (120s at rank 1). Tryndamere's item spikes are unchanged.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer has Ryze's ability slots swapped throughout: it calls Rune Prison '(E)' and Spell Flux '(W)'. Rune Prison is W, Spell Flux is E. It also states Rune Prison as an unconditional root.
audit.why: Riot's Rune Prison text: 'traps a target in a cage of runes, damaging them and slowing their movement. If the target has Flux on it, they are instead rooted.' The root is conditional on Spell Flux (E) landing first. Rune Prison is 615 range on 11/10.5/10/9.5/9; Spell Flux is 615 range on 3.5/3.25/3/2.75/2.5 and refunds Overload's cooldown.
audit.corrected: Slots corrected; the decisive interaction stated — sidestep the Spell Flux orb and Rune Prison is only a slow, so his lockdown never arrives.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns gave no numbers and pointed at the wrong gate.
audit.why: Spell Flux is back every 3.5s at rank 1, so it is not the punishable cooldown; Rune Prison at 11s is.
audit.corrected: Real numbers written in, with the Flux dependency as the actual gate.

edits.before: Spin up fury on the wave before contesting anything. Identify how Ryze contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Spin up fury on the wave, then walk him down: with no Spell Flux yet his Rune Prison only slows, so his level-1 answer is nothing.

edits.before: E lets you spin in and out of exchanges on your terms. Only take the trade when Ryze's Rune Prison is down.
edits.after: Still no root without Flux — E in, load a crit, and take the trade while Overload is his only real damage.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Ryze must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Full kit online — Spell Flux (E) into Rune Prison (W) roots you now. Sidestep the Flux orb and the cage only slows.

edits.before: Undying Rage makes you unkillable for 5 seconds — dives and coin-flip all-ins become yours. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Ryze's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Undying Rage makes you unkillable for 5 seconds and Realm Warp does nothing in a duel — but his Flux-root combo is online, so the lane still turns on one dodge.

edits.before: Level 3 evens out as Ryze gets his Overload (Q)-Rune Prison (E) root combo online, but at 4-5 you swing back — once you Spinning Slash in and Mocking Shout slow him, his short root can't peel your crits.
edits.after: Level 3 evens out as Ryze gets Spell Flux (E) into Rune Prison (W) online — Flux is what turns the cage from a slow into a root — but at 4-5 you swing back once you Spinning Slash in and Mocking Shout slows him.

edits.before: You outscale in the 1v1 — split-push and R make you the stronger duelist, and as long as you dodge his Rune Prison (E) root he has no way to survive your dive.
edits.after: You outscale in the 1v1 — split-push and R make you the stronger duelist, and if you sidestep Spell Flux (E) his Rune Prison only slows, so nothing stops your dive.

edits.before: Level 3 evens as his Q-E-W combo arrives, but by 4-5 you swing back: Spinning Slash and Mocking Shout let you stick past his short Rune Prison root and out-trade his squishy frame.
edits.after: Level 3 evens as Spell Flux into Rune Prison arrives, but by 4-5 you swing back: dodge the Flux orb and the cage only slows, so Spinning Slash and Mocking Shout keep you glued to him.

edits.before: Dodge or bait Rune Prison (E) root, then Spinning Slash in and Mocking Shout slow
edits.after: Dodge Spell Flux (E) so Rune Prison (W) only slows, then Spinning Slash in on him

edits.before: Land Rune Prison (E) root then Overload (Q) and Spell Flux (W) burst
edits.after: Land Spell Flux (E) so Rune Prison (W) roots, then Overload (Q) burst

edits.before: - Ryze Rune Prison: matchup-defining — His point-blank root — sets up his combo. Bait it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Rune Prison (W): 11s at rank 1, 615 range — it roots only through Spell Flux, so dodge the orb and it is just a slow. - Spell Flux is back every 3.5s, so respect the second one. - Undying Rage: 120s at rank 1 — kill windows only.

edits.before: Track Ryze's Rune Prison: His point-blank root — sets up his combo. Bait it. When it is down — Spin in, crit him down.
edits.after: Rune Prison (W) roots only a Flux-marked target — sidestep Spell Flux (E) and the cage is just a slow. Then spin in.

edits.before: His point-blank root — sets up his combo. Bait it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Rune Prison is 615 range and roots only through Flux — dodge the orb and it only slows.

notes: The content layer had Ryze's W and E slots swapped everywhere (Rune Prison written as E, Spell Flux as W); corrected in every string I touched. Rows 5 and 6 left alone deliberately — see questionsForUser.
